title: Master’s Thesis: The Time is Right: Retrofitting Formal Verification onto Timers in an Operating System
description: Operating systems need timers to function correctly. Despite their critical nature, timers are notoriously difficult to test for correctness. This thesis formally verifies the correctness of a timer virtualization layer in an embedded operating system. We prove that all timers are scheduled correctly, and every callback fires according to the OS specification. We introduce a framework to model timers and present an experience report on the state of retrofitted formal verification.
